title: 生命记录 · 手机使用
description: Tasker → 服务器中继 → events 表的 phone 事件（解锁 / 切应用 / 屏幕亮灭）。⚠️ 应用时长是**推导**出来的（相邻两次切换的时间差，再裁掉灭屏时段），不是手机上报的 —— 推导逻辑在 normalize.py 的 summarize_phone()。

panels.title: 今日解锁
panels.description: 屏幕解锁次数。手机在口袋里放着时不会增加。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND metric='unlock' AND day_local = date('now','+8 hours')

panels.title: 今日切应用
panels.description: 应用切换次数。一次「打开微信看一下再回桌面」大约是 2 次。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND metric='app_switch' AND day_local = date('now','+8 hours')

panels.title: 今日亮屏
panels.description: 收到的「屏幕亮」事件数。⚠️ 只有配了 Tasker Display 事件才有，没有的话这里一直是 0，不代表没在用手机。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND metric='screen_on' AND day_local = date('now','+8 hours')

panels.title: 近 30 天日均解锁
panels.description: 有数据的天数才算分母，不是 30 天 —— 手机没上报的日子不该把平均值拉低。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT day_local), 1) AS n FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND metric='unlock' AND day_local >= date('now','+8 hours','-30 days')

panels.title: 每日解锁与切应用（近 30 天）
panels.description: 两根柱子量的是不同的东西，所以**不堆叠**：堆起来的总和没有含义。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+08:00', day_local) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN metric='unlock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '解锁', SUM(CASE WHEN metric='app_switch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '切应用' FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND day_local >= date('now','+8 hours','-30 days') GROUP BY day_local ORDER BY day_local

panels.title: 手机应用 Top 15（近 30 天，按切换次数）
panels.description: 次数 ≠ 时长。切得最勤的往往是最碎的（桌面、通知、输入法），待得最久的反而切换少。要看时长用 normalize.py 的 summarize_phone()。包名→人话的映射和 normalize.py:PHONE_APPS 是**同一套**，改了一边记得改另一边。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE value_text
           WHEN 'com.tencent.mm'      THEN 'WeChat'
           WHEN 'com.miui.home'       THEN 'Launcher'
           WHEN 'net.dinglisch.android.taskerm' THEN 'Tasker'
           WHEN 'nodomain.freeyourgadget.gadgetbridge' THEN 'Gadgetbridge'
           WHEN 'com.taobao.taobao'   THEN 'Taobao'
           WHEN 'com.taobao.idlefish' THEN 'Xianyu'
           WHEN 'com.jingdong.app.mall' THEN 'JD'
           WHEN 'com.app.shanghai.metro' THEN 'Shanghai Metro'
           WHEN 'com.deepseek.chat'   THEN 'DeepSeek'
           WHEN 'com.alibaba.aliyun'  THEN 'Alibaba Cloud'
           WHEN 'app.hiddify.com'     THEN 'Hiddify'
           WHEN 'com.tailscale.ipn'   THEN 'Tailscale'
           WHEN 'org.fdroid.fdroid'   THEN 'F-Droid'
           WHEN 'bin.mt.plus'         THEN 'MT Manager'
           WHEN 'mark.via'            THEN 'Via (browser)'
           WHEN 'com.android.camera'  THEN 'Camera'
           WHEN 'com.miui.gallery'    THEN 'Gallery'
           WHEN 'com.android.settings' THEN 'Settings'
           WHEN 'com.android.vending' THEN 'Play Store'
           WHEN 'com.android.fileexplorer' THEN 'Files'
           WHEN 'com.google.android.documentsui' THEN 'Files (picker)'
           WHEN 'com.android.photopicker' THEN 'Photo picker'
           WHEN 'com.android.permissioncontroller' THEN 'Permission dialog'
           WHEN 'com.android.intentresolver' THEN 'Share dialog'
           WHEN 'com.miui.packageinstaller' THEN 'Package installer'
           WHEN 'com.android.companiondevicemanager' THEN 'Device manager'
           WHEN 'com.miui.securitycenter' THEN 'Security'
           WHEN 'com.miui.securitycore' THEN 'Security'
           ELSE value_text END AS '应用', COUNT(*) AS '次数' FROM events WHERE domain='phone' AND metric='app_switch' AND day_local >= date('now','+8 hours','-30 days') AND value_text NOT LIKE '%APPNAME%' GROUP BY value_text ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 最近的手机事件
panels.description: 原始事件流。⚠️ '(Tasker 变量没展开)' 那几条是上报时 %APPNAME 没被替换掉，不是解析问题 —— 见本目录 README 的「已知数据缺陷」。

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(ts_utc,'+8 hours') AS '时间(本地)', day_local AS '日期', CASE metric WHEN 'unlock' THEN '解锁' WHEN 'screen_on' THEN '亮屏' WHEN 'screen_off' THEN '灭屏' WHEN 'app_switch' THEN '切应用' ELSE metric END AS '事件', CASE WHEN value_text IS NULL OR value_text = '' THEN '' WHEN value_text LIKE '%APPNAME%' THEN '(Tasker 变量没展开)' ELSE value_text END AS '应用' FROM events WHERE domain='phone' ORDER BY ts_utc DESC LIMIT 150
